description: Presentations on Biohacking at DEF CON 23 covers medical device security, honeypot deployment for healthcare infrastructure, and the ethical frontiers of human augmentation.

talks.title: Medical Devices: Pwnage and Honeypots
talks.teaser: Scott Erven and Mark Collao demonstrate systemic security failures across connected medical devices and reveal findings from deploying specialized healthcare honeypots.

talks.title: Hacking the Human Body and Brain
talks.teaser: Richard Thieme explores the philosophical, cultural, and psychological dimensions of biohacking, neural interfaces, and the technological evolution of the human mind.
talks.summary:
Biohacking and medical security: Hacking the Human Body and Brain. Exploration of security vulnerabilities in human-computer interfaces and medical devices.
